name: Queensland Explorer Pass for international students
summary: Unlimited Queensland long-distance rail travel for one or two months for overseas visitors, including student visa holders.
who: Genuine overseas visitors to Australia, including international visitors on working holiday and student visas.
catches: Passes must not be used to travel between two stations more than twice.
Purchasers have twelve months from the date of purchase to commence travel.
